**What deleting a provisioned throughput involves**
- The API call is `DeleteProvisionedModelThroughput`. It is a permanent action.
- AWS blocks deletion until the commitment term is over. If it was bought with a 1-month or 6-month commitment, you can't delete it early. You'd keep paying the hourly rate for the model units until the term ends.
- A no-commitment provisioned throughput can be deleted at any time. Billing stops once it's deleted.
- Anything calling the provisioned model's ARN will start failing after deletion. Check that your apps and any inference profiles have switched to the on-demand model ID first.
